# 🐍 Pyhub — Python Reference & Workshop
![PWA](https://img.shields.io/badge/PWA-Ready-00ff88) ![Offline](https://img.shields.io/badge/Offline-First-4fc3f7) ![Zero deps](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-zero-ffd700) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green) **Your complete Python reference ecosystem — commands, favorites, search, export, and an interactive workshop in one place.** [🚀 **Live Demo**](https://imxforever.github.io/Pyhub/) • [🧪 Workshop](https://imxforever.github.io/Pyhub/index_online.html) • [📘 Offline Reference](https://imxforever.github.io/Pyhub/index_offline.html)

## ✨ Features | Feature | Description | |---------|-------------| | 📘 **Command Reference** | 100+ Python commands with syntax, description, and examples. Categorized (Basics, Strings, Lists, OOP, etc.). | | ⭐ **Favorites System** | Star your most-used commands. Access them instantly from the Favorites tab. | | 🔍 **Search & Filter** | Search commands by name, syntax, or description. Filter by category. | | 🧪 **Interactive Workshop** | Write and run Python code in the browser (Pyodide). Challenges with starter code and solution checking. | | 📤 **Export** | Export all commands to JSON or CSV for backup, analysis, or sharing. | | ℹ️ **Detail Modal** | Click any command for full syntax, description, and example. Copy syntax with one click. | | 📱 **PWA Ready** | Install on any device (phone, tablet, desktop) as a native app. Works offline via service worker. | | 🏆 **Achievements** | 12+ trophies to unlock: First Command, First Favorite, Search Master, First Run, and more. | | 🎲 **Random Discovery** | Hit 🎲 Random to discover a new command. Great for learning. | | 🌓 **Dark Neon Theme** | Built-in dark theme with neon green accents. | ## 🚀 Live demo Hosted free on **GitHub Pages** — no server, no build step: - 🏠 Hub: - 🧪 Online Workshop (needs internet for Pyodide CDN): - 📘 Offline Reference: > 💡 Installable as an app: open the demo on your phone → *Add to Home Screen*. ## 🖥️ Run locally ```bash git clone https://github.com/ImXforever/Pyhub.git cd Pyhub python3 -m http.server 8000 # → http://localhost:8000 ``` ## 📁 Structure ``` ├── index.html landing hub (links to workshop + reference) ├── index_online.html interactive Pyodide workshop ├── index_offline.html offline command reference ├── service-worker.js offline caching ├── manifest.json PWA manifest └── icon-*.png app icons ``` ## 🛠 Tech stack Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS · Pyodide (in-browser Python) · Service Worker · Web App Manifest — **zero dependencies, zero backend.** ## 📄 License [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 ImXforever

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=yes" />
    <title>Pyhub – Python Reference Pro</title>
    <link rel="manifest" href="manifest.json" />
    <meta name="theme-color" content="#0a0a14" />
    <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes" />
    <meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent" />

    <style>
        :root {
            --neon-green: #00ff88;
            --neon-green-dim: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.10);
            --neon-green-glow: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.18);
            --neon-red: #ff3860;
            --neon-blue: #4fc3f7;
            --neon-blue-dim: rgba(79, 195, 247, 0.08);
            --neon-white: #e8e8f0;
            --dark-bg: #0a0a14;
            --sidebar-bg: rgba(10, 10, 20, 0.94);
            --card-bg: rgba(16, 16, 28, 0.80);
            --card-hover-bg: rgba(20, 20, 36, 0.92);
            --glass-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            --glass-border-strong: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.15);
            --radius: 14px;
            --radius-sm: 10px;
            --radius-xs: 7px;
            --font: 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, sans-serif;
            --transition: 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94);
            --sidebar-w: 270px;
            --bottom-nav-h: 62px;
            --header-h: 56px;
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
        }

        @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;600;700;800;900&display=swap');

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
            height: 100%;
        }
        body {
            font-family: var(--font);
            background: var(--dark-bg);
            color: var(--neon-white);
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            position: relative;
        }

        /* ===== CANVAS ===== */
        #particles-canvas {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            z-index: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* ===== APP SHELL ===== */
        .app-shell {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            display: flex;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
        }

        /* ===== SIDEBAR ===== */
        .sidebar {
            width: var(--sidebar-w);
            min-width: var(--sidebar-w);
            height: 100%;
            background: var(--sidebar-bg);
            border-right: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            padding: 0;
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            overflow-y: auto;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94);
            z-index: 100;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .sidebar-header {
            padding: 1.2rem 1.2rem 0.8rem 1.2rem;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .sidebar-logo {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            font-size: 1.3rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            color: var(--neon-green);
            text-decoration: none;
            letter-spacing: -0.3px;
        }
        .sidebar-logo .sub {
            font-weight: 300;
            color: rgba(232, 232, 240, 0.45);
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .sidebar-search-wrap {
            padding: 0.8rem 1.2rem;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .sidebar-search-wrap input {
            width: 100%;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
            border-radius: 25px;
            padding: 0.55rem 1rem 0.55rem 2.2rem;
            color: var(--neon-white);
            font-family: var(--font);
            font-size: 0.82rem;
            outline: none;
            transition: 0.3s;
        }
        .sidebar-search-wrap input:focus {
            border-color: var(--neon-green-glow);
            box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.05);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
        }
        .sidebar-search-wrap {
            position: relative;
        }
        .sidebar-search-wrap .search-icon {
            position: absolute;
            left: 1.6rem;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: rgba(232, 232, 240, 0.3);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .sidebar-nav {
            flex: 1;
            overflow-y: auto;
            padding: 0.4rem 0.6rem 1rem 0.6rem;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.15rem;
        }

        .sidebar-nav .nav-section-title {
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1.5px;
            color: rgba(232, 232, 240, 0.2);
            padding: 0.7rem 0.6rem 0.3rem 0.6rem;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .sidebar-nav button {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.55rem;
            width: 100%;
            text-align: left;
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: rgba(232, 232, 240, 0.55);
            font-family: var(--font);
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            padding: 0.5rem 0.7rem;
            border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: 0.22s;
            white-space: nowrap;
            font-weight: 500;
        }
        .sidebar-nav button:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
            color: var(--neon-white);
        }
        .sidebar-nav button.active {
            background: var(--neon-green-dim);
            color: var(--neon-green);
            font-weight: 700;
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.1);
        }
        .sidebar-nav button .badge-cnt {
            margin-left: auto;
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem;
            border-radius: 15px;
            color: rgba(232, 232, 240, 0.3);
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        .sidebar-nav button.active .badge-cnt {
            background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.1);
            color: var(--neon-green);
        }

        .sidebar-footer {
            padding: 0.8rem 1.2rem;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            color: rgba(232, 232, 240, 0.15);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .sidebar-footer .dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            background: var(--neon-green);
            border-radius: 50%;
            display: inline-block;
            animation: pulse-dot 2s infinite;
        }
        @keyframes pulse-dot {
            0%,
            100% {
                opacity: 0.4;
            }
            50% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        /* ===== MAIN CONTENT ===== */
        .main-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        .main-top-bar {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 1rem;
            padding: 0.6rem 1.5rem;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            flex-shrink: 0;
            background: rgba(10, 10, 20, 0.7);
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            min-height: var(--header-h);
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }

        .main-top-bar .breadcrumb {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.4rem;
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: rgba(232, 232, 240, 0.35);
            font-weight: 500;
        }
        .main-top-bar .breadcrumb .active-bread {
            color: var(--neon-white);
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        .main-top-bar .breadcrumb .sep {
            color: rgba(232, 232, 240, 0.15);
        }

        .main-top-bar .actions-row {
            margin-left: auto;
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .main-top-bar .actions-row button {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            color: rgba(232, 232, 240, 0.55);
            padding: 0.35rem 0.9rem;
            border-radius: 20px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-family: var(--font);
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            transition: 0.25s;
            white-space: nowrap;
            font-weight: 500;
        }
        .main-top-bar .actions-row button:hover {
            border-color: var(--neon-green-glow);
            color: var(--neon-white);
            background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.03);
        }
        .main-top-bar .actions-row button.fav-active {
            border-color: rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.3);
            color: #ffd700;
            background: rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.04);
        }

        .main-scroll {
            flex: 1;
            overflow-y: auto;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            padding: 1.2rem 1.5rem 1.5rem 1.5rem;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        /* ===== COMMAND LIST ===== */
        .command-list {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(300px, 1fr));
            gap: 1rem;
        }

        .command-card {
            background: var(--card-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 1.1rem 1.2rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: var(--transition);
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            min-height: 130px;
        }
        .command-card:hover {
            background: var(--card-hover-bg);
            border-color: var(--glass-border-strong);
            transform: translateY(-3px);
            box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), 0 0 60px rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.03);
        }
        .command-card .card-top {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 0.5rem;
        }
        .command-card .card-icon {
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .command-card .card-name {
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 0.95rem;
            color: var(--neon-white);
            line-height: 1.3;
        }
        .command-card .card-cat-tag {
            font-size: 0.58rem;
            padding: 0.15rem 0.55rem;
            border-radius: 12px;
            background: var(--neon-blue-dim);
            border: 1px solid rgba(79, 195, 247, 0.1);
            color: var(--neon-blue);
            white-space: nowrap;
            font-weight: 600;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .command-card .card-syntax-preview {
            font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
            font-size: 0.78rem;
            background: #141424;
            padding: 0.5rem 0.7rem;
            border-radius: var(--radius-xs);
            color: #b0d0ff;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
            white-space: nowrap;
            border-left: 3px solid var(--neon-green);
        }
        .command-card .card-desc {
            font-size: 0.78rem;
            color: rgba(232, 232, 240, 0.5);
            line-height: 1.5;
            display: -webkit-box;
            -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
            -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .command-card .card-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            align-items: center;
            margin-top: auto;
            padding-top: 0.4rem;
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
        }
        .command-card .card-actions button {
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: rgba(232, 232, 240, 0.25);
            font-size: 0.7rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem;
            border-radius: 12px;
            transition: 0.25s;
            font-family: var(--font);
        }
        .command-card .card-actions button:hover {
            color: var(--neon-green);
            background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.04);
        }
        .command-card .card-actions button.fav-btn.saved {
            color: #ffd700;
        }

        /* ===== EMPTY STATE ===== */
        .empty-state {
            grid-column: 1 / -1;
            text-align: center;
            padding: 3rem 1rem;
            color: rgba(232, 232, 240, 0.18);
        }
        .empty-state .icon {
            font-size: 3rem;
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 0.6rem;
        }
        .empty-state .sub {
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            color: rgba(232, 232, 240, 0.12);
            margin-top: 0.3rem;
        }

        /* ===== DETAIL MODAL ===== */
        .modal-overlay {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
            z-index: 9999;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 1rem;
            animation: fadeIn 0.2s ease-out;
        }
        .modal-overlay.closing {
            animation: fadeOut 0.2s ease-in forwards;
        }
        @keyframes fadeIn {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
            }
            to {
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        @keyframes fadeOut {
            from {
                opacity: 1;
            }
            to {
                opacity: 0;
            }
        }

        .modal-card {
            background: #12121f;
            border: 1px solid var(--glass-border-strong);
            border-radius: var(--radius);
            padding: 1.5rem;
            max-width: 600px;
            width: 100%;
            max-height: 85vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
            box-shadow: 0 20px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
            position: relative;
            animation: slideUp 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94);
        }
        @keyframes slideUp {
            from {
                transform: translateY(40px);
                opacity: 0;
            }
            to {
                transform: translateY(0);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }
        .modal-card .modal-close {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0.8rem;
            right: 1rem;
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: rgba(232, 232, 240, 0.4);
            font-size: 1.4rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: 0.3s;
            padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;
            border-radius: 50%;
        }
        .modal-card .modal-close:hover {
            color: #fff;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
        }
        .modal-card h2 {
            font-size: 1.3rem;
            margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
            color: var(--neon-white);
        }
        .modal-card .modal-syntax {
            background: #1a1a2e;
            padding: 1rem;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            color: #b8e0ff;
            white-space: pre-wrap;
            margin: 0.8rem 0;
            cursor: pointer;
            position: relative;
            border-left: 3px solid var(--neon-green);
        }
        .modal-card .modal-example {
            background: #1e2a1e;
            padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
            font-size: 0.82rem;
            color: #b8ffb8;
            border-left: 3px solid #4caf50;
            margin: 0.5rem 0;
        }
        .modal-card .modal-desc {
            color: rgba(232, 232, 240, 0.6);
            font-size: 0.9rem;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        /* ===== MOBILE BOTTOM NAV ===== */
        .bottom-nav {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: var(--bottom-nav-h);
            background: rgba(10, 10, 20, 0.95);
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            z-index: 200;
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
            justify-content: space-around;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 0 0.5rem;
            padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0);
        }
        .bottom-nav button {
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: rgba(232, 232, 240, 0.35);
            font-family: var(--font);
            font-size: 0.6rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.25rem;
            padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem;
            border-radius: 12px;
            transition: 0.25s;
            font-weight: 600;
        }
        .bottom-nav button .nav-icon {
            font-size: 1.3rem;
        }
        .bottom-nav button.active {
            color: var(--neon-green);
        }

        /* ===== SIDEBAR OVERLAY (mobile) ===== */
        .sidebar-overlay {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
            z-index: 99;
        }

        /* ===== TOAST ===== */
        .toast {
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 5rem;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(100px);
            background: rgba(18, 18, 30, 0.95);
            border: 1px solid var(--glass-border-strong);
            border-radius: 25px;
            padding: 0.6rem 1.6rem;
            backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
            color: var(--neon-white);
            font-size: 0.8rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            z-index: 99999;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .toast.show {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
        }
        .toast.success {
            border-color: var(--neon-green);
        }

        /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
        @media (max-width: 900px) {
            .sidebar {
                position: fixed;
                left: 0;
                top: 0;
                height: 100%;
                transform: translateX(-105%);
                box-shadow: 8px 0 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
                width: 280px;
                min-width: 280px;
            }
            .sidebar.open {
                transform: translateX(0);
            }
            .sidebar-overlay.show {
                display: block;
            }
            .main-content {
                width: 100%;
            }
            .main-scroll {
                padding: 0.8rem 0.8rem 5rem 0.8rem;
            }
            .main-top-bar {
                padding: 0.5rem 0.8rem;
                gap: 0.5rem;
            }
            .bottom-nav {
                display: flex;
            }
            .command-list {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
                gap: 0.7rem;
            }
            .command-card {
                padding: 0.8rem 0.9rem;
                min-height: 110px;
            }
            .command-card .card-name {
                font-size: 0.82rem;
            }
            .command-card .card-syntax-preview {
                font-size: 0.7rem;
            }
            .command-card .card-desc {
                font-size: 0.7rem;
            }
            .main-top-bar .actions-row button {
                font-size: 0.65rem;
                padding: 0.3rem 0.7rem;
            }
            .hamburger-btn {
                display: flex !important;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 500px) {
            .command-list {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            .main-scroll {
                padding: 0.6rem 0.6rem 5rem 0.6rem;
            }
        }

        .hamburger-btn {
            display: none;
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            color: var(--neon-white);
            font-size: 1.3rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 0.3rem 0.5rem;
            border-radius: 8px;
            transition: 0.3s;
        }
        .hamburger-btn:hover {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
        }

        /* Scrollbar */
        ::-webkit-scrollbar {
            width: 4px;
            height: 4px;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
            background: transparent;
        }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
            background: rgba(0, 255, 136, 0.2);
            border-radius: 10px;
        }

        /* Utility */
        .sr-only {
            position: absolute;
            width: 1px;
            height: 1px;
            padding: 0;
            margin: -1px;
            overflow: hidden;
            clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
            border: 0;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <canvas id="particles-canvas"></canvas>

    <!-- ===== APP SHELL ===== -->
    <div class="app-shell" id="app-shell">

        <!-- SIDEBAR -->

            const canvas = document.getElementById('particles-canvas');
            const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
            let W, H, particles = [];
            const PARTICLE_COUNT = 80;
            const COLORS = ['rgba(0,255,136,', 'rgba(79,195,247,', 'rgba(232,232,240,'];

            class Particle {
                constructor() { this.reset(); }
                reset() {
                    this.x = Math.random() * W;
                    this.y = Math.random() * H;
                    this.size = Math.random() * 2 + 0.4;
                    this.speedX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4;
                    this.speedY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4;
                    this.opacity = Math.random() * 0.35 + 0.08;
                    this.colorIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * COLORS.length);
                    this.pulse = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                    this.pulseSpeed = 0.005 + Math.random() * 0.01;
                }
                update() {
                    this.x += this.speedX;
                    this.y += this.speedY;
                    this.pulse += this.pulseSpeed;
                    if (this.x < 0 || this.x > W) { this.speedX *= -1;
                        this.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W, this.x)); }
                    if (this.y < 0 || this.y > H) { this.speedY *= -1;
                        this.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H, this.y)); }
                    this.currentOpacity = this.opacity * (0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(this.pulse));
                }
                draw() {
                    const alpha = Math.max(0.02, Math.min(0.7, this.currentOpacity));
                    const color = COLORS[this.colorIdx] + alpha + ')';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fillStyle = color;
                    ctx.shadowColor = color;
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
                }
            }

            function initParticles() {
                particles = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < PARTICLE_COUNT; i++) particles.push(new Particle());
            }

            function resizeCanvas() { W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
                H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight; }

            function drawParticles() {
                ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
                const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, 0, W / 2, H / 2, Math.max(W, H) * 0.7);
                grad.addColorStop(0, '#0c0c18');
                grad.addColorStop(1, '#04040a');
                ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
                particles.forEach(p => { p.update();
                    p.draw(); });
                for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
                    for (let j = i + 1; j < particles.length; j++) {
                        const dx = particles[i].x - particles[j].x;
                        const dy = particles[i].y - particles[j].y;
                        const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
                        const maxDist = 120;
                        if (dist < maxDist) {
                            const alpha = (1 - dist / maxDist) * 0.1;
                            ctx.beginPath();
                            ctx.moveTo(particles[i].x, particles[i].y);
                            ctx.lineTo(particles[j].x, particles[j].y);
                            ctx.strokeStyle = COLORS[0] + alpha + ')';
                            ctx.lineWidth = 0.35;
                            ctx.stroke();
                        }
                    }
                }
                requestAnimationFrame(drawParticles);
            }

                    filtered = COMMANDS.filter(c => c.cat === currentCategory);

                    filtered = filtered.filter(c =>

                        c.syntax.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
                        c.desc.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||

            const PARTICLE_COUNT = 80;
            const COLORS = ['rgba(0,255,136,', 'rgba(79,195,247,', 'rgba(232,232,240,'];

            class Particle {
                constructor() { this.reset(); }
                reset() {
                    this.x = Math.random() * W;
                    this.y = Math.random() * H;
                    this.size = Math.random() * 2 + 0.4;
                    this.speedX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4;
                    this.speedY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4;
                    this.opacity = Math.random() * 0.35 + 0.08;
                    this.colorIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * COLORS.length);
                    this.pulse = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
                    this.pulseSpeed = 0.005 + Math.random() * 0.01;
                }
                update() {
                    this.x += this.speedX;
                    this.y += this.speedY;
                    this.pulse += this.pulseSpeed;
                    if (this.x < 0 || this.x > W) { this.speedX *= -1;
                        this.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W, this.x)); }
                    if (this.y < 0 || this.y > H) { this.speedY *= -1;
                        this.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H, this.y)); }
                    this.currentOpacity = this.opacity * (0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(this.pulse));
                }
                draw() {
                    const alpha = Math.max(0.02, Math.min(0.7, this.currentOpacity));
                    const color = COLORS[this.colorIdx] + alpha + ')';
                    ctx.beginPath();
                    ctx.arc(this.x, this.y, this.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                    ctx.fillStyle = color;
                    ctx.shadowColor = color;
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
                    ctx.fill();
                    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
                }
            }

                particles = [];
                for (let i = 0; i < PARTICLE_COUNT; i++) particles.push(new Particle());
            }

            function resizeCanvas() { W = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
                H = canvas.height = window.innerHeight; }

            function drawParticles() {
                ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
                const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(W / 2, H / 2, 0, W / 2, H / 2, Math.max(W, H) * 0.7);
                grad.addColorStop(0, '#0c0c18');
                grad.addColorStop(1, '#04040a');
                ctx.fillStyle = grad;
                ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

                    p.draw(); });
                for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {

                            ctx.lineWidth = 0.35;
                            ctx.stroke();
                        }
